hud.prompt: Ask about a project or give a command
hud.privacyLocal: The wake word is detected on this device; no audio leaves it
hud.typedOnly: Speech recognition is off. Type a command, or choose an engine in Voice settings.
hud.confirmHint: Say “yes” or “no”, or use the buttons.

reply.stopFailed: I’m afraid I couldn’t stop the AI work{{addr}}. Use the emergency stop button.

reply.approvalGone: That approval request is no longer pending. Nothing was approved or rejected.

reply.dndFailed: I’m afraid I couldn’t change Do Not Disturb{{addr}}.
reply.askNeedsProject: Open a project{{addr}}, and I’ll pass this to its Manager.
reply.sentToManager: Passed to the Manager{{addr}}. I’ll read out the answer.

natural.idle_v0: All quiet{{addr}}: no agents are working.
natural.idle_v1: All calm at the moment{{addr}} — none of the agents are busy.
natural.working_v0: Work is underway{{addr}}: {{tasks}} in progress and {{agents}}.
natural.doneTodaySingle: One task is already done today.
natural.approvalsSingle: one request is waiting for your approval
natural.approvals_one: {{count}} request is waiting for your approval
natural.approvals_other: {{count}} requests are waiting for your approval
natural.offerErrors: Want me to show the errors?

confirm.stopAll: Stop all AI work in every project{{addr}}?

managerPrompts.runQa: Run QA for the project {{name}}: build it, run the test suite, review the latest changes and report the problems you find.

notify.enabledDesc: Short phrases for important events, in the agent's voice when it has one.

eventsDesc.taskFailed: A task ended with an error.
eventsDesc.approvalNeeded: An action waits for your confirmation.
eventsDesc.buildFailed: A build of a project failed.
eventsDesc.budgetThreshold: Spending reached a budget warning level or the limit.

notify.quietHoursDesc: No spoken notifications during these hours (local time).
notify.criticalNote: A budget overrun is announced even in Do Not Disturb and quiet hours.

errors.micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your system privacy settings.
errors.sttUnsupported: This speech engine isn't available here.
errors.sttDisabled: Speech recognition is off — pick an engine in Settings → Voice.
errors.sttNoModel: The speech model isn't installed — download it in Voice models.

general.enabledDesc: Push-to-talk, the voice panel and the wake word.
general.hotkeyDesc: Hold the keys while you speak; release to run the command. Ctrl shortcuts are left to the code editor and the terminal while they have focus.
general.spokenRepliesDesc: Read short answers to voice commands aloud.
general.naturalRepliesDesc: Phrase answers conversationally with the Manager's model. Built-in phrasing when no model is available.

mic.deviceDesc: Used for push-to-talk, the wake word and enrollment.
mic.deviceNoLabels: Device names appear after you allow microphone access once (run a test).
mic.testDesc: Check the input level. Nothing is recorded or sent.

stt.engineDesc: Recognition starts only after push-to-talk or the wake word — never continuously.

engineHints.WebSpeech: Built into the webview; audio goes to the browser's speech service
engineHints.OpenAiWhisper: Audio goes to OpenAI with your key or provider
engineHints.WhisperCpp: Runs on this computer; multilingual, accurate
engineHints.Vosk: Runs on this computer; small and very fast
engineHints.SherpaOnnx: Runs on this computer; fast streaming models
engineHints.WindowsSpeech: Built into Windows; needs the language's speech pack
engineHints.Deepgram: Audio goes to Deepgram with your API key
engineHints.AzureSpeech: Audio goes to Microsoft Azure with your API key
engineHints.GoogleCloud: Audio goes to Google Cloud with your API key
engineHints.YandexSpeechKit: Audio goes to Yandex Cloud with your API key

stt.webSpeechMissing: Web Speech recognition isn't available in this webview
stt.disabledNote: With recognition off, use the voice panel to type commands. The wake word still opens it.

sttText.WebSpeech: After push-to-talk or the wake word, the audio of your command is sent to the speech service of the webview (Microsoft or Google). The wake word itself is always detected on this device.
sttText.OpenAiWhisper: After push-to-talk or the wake word, the audio of your command (up to 15 seconds) is sent to OpenAI with your API key and deleted from memory right after recognition. The wake word itself is always detected on this device.
sttText.Cloud: After push-to-talk or the wake word, the audio of your command (up to 15 seconds) is sent to {{engine}} with your API key and deleted from memory right after recognition. The wake word itself is always detected on this device.

consent.ttsText: The text of replies and notifications is sent to OpenAI to synthesize speech. No audio from your microphone is sent.
consent.ttsTextEngine: The text of replies and notifications is sent to {{engine}} to synthesize speech. No audio from your microphone is sent.

wake.privacyText: Your samples and the detector stay on this computer. Audio is analysed locally and discarded; nothing is sent until the wake word is heard.
wake.enabledDesc: Record samples first. The microphone indicator stays on while listening.
wake.phraseDesc: A short word that's easy to recognize, e.g. “Jarvis” or “Оркестр”.
wake.enrollHint: Say the phrase {{min}}–{{max}} times, pausing between repetitions.
wake.enrollRecording: Say “{{phrase}}”, then pause. Repeat until the circles fill.

problems.tooShort: Too short. Say the whole phrase.
problems.tooLong: Too long. Say only the phrase, then pause.
problems.tooQuiet: Too quiet. Speak a little louder or move closer.
problems.inconsistent: That sounded different from the other samples. Try again.

wake.phraseChanged: The phrase changed. Record new samples.
wake.sensitivityDesc: Higher reacts more easily but triggers by mistake more often.
wake.cpuBudgetDesc: Average share of one CPU core the detector may use.
wake.cpuBudgetLoad: Current load: {{load}} of one CPU core.

tts.cloudVoiceDesc: Falls back to the system voice when the service is unavailable.
tts.testDesc: Plays a sample with the current settings.
tts.sample: Hello! All agents are working, and nothing needs your attention right now.
tts.coreVoiceNote: Pick the voice of this engine under Speech engines below.

cloud.providerDesc: An OpenAI provider with an API key.
cloud.none: Add an OpenAI provider in Settings → AI Providers.

agents.desc: Each agent can speak in its own voice in notifications and replies.
agents.sample: Hi, I'm {{name}}. The task is done.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Only transcripts of commands are logged, never audio. The microphone indicator in the title bar is on whenever the microphone is in use.

engines.byLanguageDesc: Recognition and voice for each language; otherwise the selected engines are used.
engines.fallbackDesc: Tried in order when the engine fails.
engines.fallbackTtsDesc: Tried in order when the engine fails; the system voice is always the last resort.
engines.cardsDesc: Every engine with what it can do on this computer.

barge.enabledDesc: While the assistant speaks or works, say a stop phrase — no wake word needed. Spotted on this device by the offline Vosk model (Settings → Voice → Models: “Vosk small Russian”); audio never leaves the computer.
barge.hardDesc: Silence speech and cancel the reply, the AI request or the running action (one per line or comma-separated).
barge.softDesc: Only silence speech; a running action goes on.
barge.softModeDesc: Silence phrases can also cancel the running action.
barge.sensitivityDesc: Higher accepts quieter and shorter phrases (more accidental stops).

followUp.enabled: Continue the conversation without the wake word
followUp.enabledDesc: After a reply the assistant keeps listening for a few seconds, so you can just go on talking. Silence, “thanks, that's all” or a stop phrase end the conversation.
followUp.windowDesc: How long to wait for you to start speaking. While you speak, it waits until you finish.
followUp.chimeDesc: A soft sound when the follow-up window closes in silence.

sound.title: Sounds and notifications
sound.enabledDesc: Synthesized on the fly; quieter and simpler in Performance and Battery Saver modes.
sound.previewDesc: Click a sound to hear it.
sound.previewLite: Simplified sounds play in the current performance mode.
sound.dndOnText: Sounds and spoken notifications are muted, except alerts. Change it in General.
